budget.runtime: codex-cli 0.164.0, ephemeral fresh sessions, existing ChatGPT auth; no API-key copying
budget.scope: Five known multi-constraint task texts x Cairn/raw; one fresh valid attempt per pair, alternating order
budget.final_output_request: <=1800 tokens (prompt limit, not a decoder setting)
budget.coding_tools: same read-only shell, local Python tests allowed, no network requests or source edits
budget.source_evidence: MCP only for Cairn/BM25; curated copied docs and rg for raw arm
budget.known_cases: All five task texts have been exposed during previous development. Not held-out/generalization validation.
budget.usage: CLI turn.completed totals, including cached_input_tokens and output_tokens; not dollar billing or cross-model comparable token counts
changes: Opt-in evidence view with whole original blocks, neighboring prose, source spans and global budget.
CLI help typed as text/console is split into options with usage/group scope; arbitrary code remains atomic.
MCP descriptions advertise evidence view; agent choice remains autonomous; no workflow prompt or oracle answers injected.
budget.attempt_selection: One valid attempt for each pair; retain all old and new runs, including failures.
budget.acceptance: Independent executable grader + manual source/requirements review. All valid failures preserved.
budget.parity_gate: Same task acceptance; compare cumulative total input I, uncached input U and output O. Componentwise no increase supports token-cost parity for nonnegative output prices and 0<=cached<=uncached input price. Indexing/latency still separate; single runs cannot prove stability.

joint.escalation: After independent acceptance, extend to the three remaining frozen known cases only if the development pair has no increase in total input I, uncached input U or output O against fresh raw. Otherwise stop this candidate screen and record failure, without a generalization claim.
